Now Q can be on Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday or Sunday — make 4 cases.
Case Q on Wednesday: clue 1 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case Q on Friday: clue 1 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case Q on Sunday: clue 1 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case Q on Tuesday survives.
Clue 1 → U on Friday; V takes the only place left: Wednesday.
P takes the only place left: Sunday.
Final arrangement: Monday – T, Tuesday – Q, Wednesday – V, Thursday – S, Friday – U, Saturday – R, Sunday – P.
From the final arrangement, Saturday → **R**.

solution.trap: **P** would be on Saturday only if clue 3 were ignored — clue 3 rules that arrangement out.
